race.comment: TOUT BELLE (1) showed little early speed at her last couple, the latest finishing sixth (18.03) in a NG at this track. Good beginner assisted by the inside draw. Tough to beat if on-song. MIDWEEK SCOTCHES (2) returned a better run last time, finishing in the money (17.52) at this track behind Messy And Untidy in a NG. Has the early speed to land on the pace and can stick on. Must be included in calculations. DOLLY DAWN (7) was strongly fancied and drifted back but wound up hard to hit the frame, 4.5 lengths from the winner (17.65) at this track in Grade 3/4. The form from her last run stacks up well. Can measure up. KINGSBRAE MAGGIE (5) gets a chance to improve on an unplaced run at her latest outing at this circuit.
